items.title: Tesla's new partnership: Swedish company Einride to deploy 500 Tesla semi-truck EVs
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is partnering with Swedish trucking company Einride (ENRD), which is deploying 500 of Tesla's electric semi-trucks. Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman explains the details.

items.title: What does Tesla's Cybercab launch mean for SpaceX's own ambitions?
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) showcased its new Cybercab — a version of its autonomous robotaxi without a steering wheel — ahead of its planned launch in Austin, Texas. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley and Barron's associate editor Al Root to discuss this story and what it could represent for Elon Musk's ambitions for SpaceX.

items.title: Elon Musk's 'Bank' Will Pay A Risk-Free 6% Yield On Your Cash
items.summary: Tired of bonds falling or tying your cash up in "high-yield" savings accounts paying just 3.4%? Elon Musk's X is pitching an alternative.

items.title: Unitree Stock Soars 460% in China Debut as Robot Maker Takes on Musk
items.summary: If humanoid robots are the future, then Elon Musk faces a formidable Chinese rival.  China’s  Unitree Robotics  surged 460% on its trading debut in Shanghai Wednesday, giving the company a market capitalization of around $51 billion.  Unitree’s new humanoid robot has gone viral recently, appearing to beat Usain Bolt’s fastest speed and jump higher than a human.

items.title: Unitree Robotics stock soars 460% in Shanghai IPO debut
items.summary: The Hangzhou-based humanoid robot maker closed at 845 yuan on Wednesday, giving it a market value of around $50 billion
